answer: A forged receipt fails at the first cross-check, because the issuer keeps a copy of its own. One mask pays 122 POA and waits 7 days; a farm pays 79178 POA and still waits 7 days per mask. The evidence carries a date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot claim to be a year old. Give the epoch a backbone: Brick maker floor tile seal fired in the mould loft, proved by each floor tile is a measured kiln yield plus a guild signature, checked by strangers. The quartz points at a person the farm never met, the garden points at a sum the farm never owned, the copper points at a year the farm never lived.
